# `auth.login`

Sign in with a password

Verifies an argon2id password, rotates the session, and sets the session cookie.

- Method and path: `POST /login`
- Scope: `public:read`
- Kind: `mutation`
- CLI: `rukie auth login`
- MCP: `auth_login`
- Idempotency-Key: required on this mutation

## Inputs

| Name | In | Required | Type |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `$schema` | body | no | `string` |
| `Idempotency-Key` | header | no | `string` |
| `password` | body | yes | `string` |
| `username` | body | yes | `string` |

## Errors

`rate-limited`, `unauthorized`, plus the framework problems.
